signals.text: Arsenal's injured Caldentey out for up to 10 weeks. Arsenal midfielder Mariona Caldentey is set to miss about two months of Women's Super League action because of a hamstring injury.
'Shameless' - Mourinho critical of Vinicius Jr ban timing. Real Madrid forward Vinicius Jr will miss El Clasico against Barcelona after being given a four-game ban.
